Prepared for OnlyFans · October 2026 · Strictly confidential
W W W . Y . U N O
OnlyFans needs one vault that every provider can use, under its own rules
, with one place for every sensitive record: fan cards, network tokens and creator identity, tax and bank data.
Today fan cards sit with the processor and creator data sits in OnlyFans systems.
means moving sensitive data again, and
has to be secured and audited.
OnlyFans is selecting a token vault provider through the
and how freely OnlyFans can add, swap or leave providers.

One PCI DSS Level 1 Yuno Vault for cards, network tokens and creator data, a proxy that delivers each value only to the provider that needs it, and portable tokens with the exit written into the contract.
Fan cards live with your processor and creator data lives in your systems
Fan cards are locked to the processor that stores them
Two systems to secure and audit
A new provider means collecting creator details again
OnlyFans Privacy Policy: "We do not receive your full payment card number." Read 8 Oct 2026.
Cards work on any processor you connect
One vault to secure and audit
Creator details collected once and reused
Yuno's vault does everything a standalone vault does, plus the connections, with far less to build
Stores the data. The rest is yours to build or buy.
Stores the data, connects it to providers and runs payments on it.
PCI DSS Level 1 storage   ·   Tokenisation   ·   Proxy to providers   ·   Portable tokens and contractual exit
Cards and tokens; other data varies by vendor
Cards, network tokens, bank, identity and tax data
Each processor and bank connection, built and run in-house
Routing, retries, failover and payouts, built in-house
A new vendor and integration for each service
3DS, account updater, network tokens and payouts
Same independence, far less to build.
OnlyFans keeps portable tokens and exit terms, and decides how much of the stack Yuno runs.
Fan cards are stored once and work on every processor you connect
Hosted fields on web, iOS and Android. No charge needed. The CVV is never stored.
The account updater refreshes cards. The vaulted token stays the same. PAR identifies the unique card behind every credential.
Import from your current processor as a PGP-encrypted file over SFTP. Export is documented.
Add or swap a processor and the stored cards keep working, with nothing collected again from fans.
Network tokens and PAR sit next to the card, so one fan stays one fanacross every credential
One fan across card, wallet and reissue: for chargebacks, bans
Token requestor ID registered under OnlyFans where the scheme
allows it. Yuno acts as TS-TRP.
Creator identity, tax and bank data get the same Level 1 protection as a card
Collected once at onboarding. Reused from the vault every time after.
legal name · date of birth · passport · selfies
You define the tables, the columns, how each one is protected and howlong it lives
You build the request your provider expects and mark the tokens. Theproxy fills in the real values
The controls you would build around card data come with the proxy
Exact HTTPS hosts you register. Every change lands in an append-only log.
Your client certificate per destination. The private key is write-only in KMS.
Tokens are swapped for vault values inside the request body.
One record for every call, with the destination and the result.
Request bodies are not stored or logged unless you switch it on, per destination. Card numbers echoed back are cut to the last four.
WHY YUNO  ›  VERSUS A STANDALONE VAULT
Yuno matches standalone vaults on the core and leads on everything built around it
